description: Share a calendar by creating a sharing rule: a role (freeBusyReader, reader, writer, owner) for a user, group, domain or everyone (default); send_notifications controls the email; a domain rule needs a Google Workspace account (POST calendars/{calendarId}/acl; scope calendar.acls). Runs as a background job: dispatch returns job_id/status queued at once; completion carries the vendor response (plus next_page_token/next_sync_token when Google returns them) and names the account used. API-wide query arguments: alt (json), fields (partial-response selector), pretty_print (boolean), quota_user and user_ip (deprecated). Arguments key/access_token/oauth_token are declared only to refuse credential overrides: credentials belong to the Google account contract; select credentials with account.
embedding_description: Share a Google Calendar with a person, group, a whole domain or the public by granting an access role: see free/busy only, read event details, edit events, or full owner rights; can email the person about it.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Google Calendar sharing rule creation started
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued for the Google Calendar sharing rule creation; completion with Google's response will be delivered automatically.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return exactly one action using the active IO plugin's post_message (process_key: plugin::<io_plugin>::post_message). Use the provided session_id. Keep the message short and friendly. Do NOT invent process identifiers (no present_result, no status actions).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Dispatch a background job for the Google Calendar sharing rule creation (POST calendars/{calendarId}/acl).
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: an argument does not match the vendor's Calendar API shape (unknown name, wrong type, missing required, value not allowed) or the session context is missing. gsuite.not_connected: no Google account linked. gsuite.unknown_account: 'account' names no connected account. gsuite.missing_scope: the account's grant lacks the Calendar scope this verb needs. gsuite.permission_denied: the account lacks access to that calendar or event. gsuite.not_found: the id does not exist or is not visible. gsuite.rate_limited: Google rate limit. gsuite.api_error: job creation failed or another Google error. gsuite.workspace_only: a domain-scoped rule from a consumer account.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: correct the named argument (snake_case names; pass the vendor request object as body). gsuite.not_connected or gsuite.missing_scope: run start_interface then connect_account and approve the Calendar permissions. gsuite.unknown_account: use an email or alias from the connected accounts. gsuite.not_found: list first to get a valid id. gsuite.rate_limited: retry later with backoff. gsuite.workspace_only: share with individual users instead of a domain.
